case_title: JULIO E. GODOY RIVERA VS. MARIO S. GAMAN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,000.00 FILED BY GODOY RIVERA, JULIO E. AS TO DEFENDANT GAMAN, MARIO S. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-13-2010 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-13-2010 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-13-2010 BY PAUL SLAVIT. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER NINA SAFDIE PRESENT ON PLAINTIFF'S BEHALF. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AUG-29-2010, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT GAMAN, MARIO S.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-13-2010 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GODOY RIVERA, JULIO E. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GAMAN, MARIO S. $1,417.50 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,467.50, THE COURT DETERMINES THAT THE COST OF REPAIR EXCEEDS THE VALUE OF PLAINTIFF'S TRUCK, AND THAT THE VALUE OF THE VEHICLE IS $2025.00. THE COURT FURTHER ALLOCATES 30% COMPARITIVE FAULT TO THE PLAINTIFF. THE JUDGMENT IS A NEW AWARD. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT GAMAN, MARIO S.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JUL-01-2011 ORDERED DESTROYED
